Good words to guide your usage of APIs with AI agents! 

"Get the API governance right, and the blast radius shrinks. Get it wrong, and it expands faster than any team can manage." 

Your legacy APIs were never designed to work in autonomous systems of AI agents. Agents running autonomously at "machine speed" have the potential to be SERIOUSLY disruptive, and if your  guardrails are insufficient, the adverse consequences and damages can  accumulate faster than can be detected.
